# Text a scan reading one byte at a time can trip over: nothing at all, a single
# byte, punctuation, bytes that are not valid UTF-8, and the runs that a scan
# resuming one byte along would work through candidate after candidate.

patterns: default

case: no text at all
in:
out:

case: one letter
in:   a
out:  a

case: one space
in:   \x20
out:  \x20

case: a run of dots
in:   ....
out:  ....

case: a run of underscores
in:   ____________________
out:  ____________________

case: a run of hyphens
in:   ----------------------------------------
out:  ----------------------------------------

case: a run of base64url characters
in:   0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-_
out:  0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-_

case: control bytes
in:   \x00\x01\x02
out:  \x00\x01\x02

case: bytes that are not valid utf-8
in:   \xff\xfe
out:  \xff\xfe

case: text in japanese
in:   日本語
out:  日本語

case: a lone carriage return and newline
in:   \r\n
out:  \r\n

case: header prefixes with nothing behind them
in:   eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ
out:  eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ

case: header prefixes ending in something that is not a token
in:   eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ.a.b
out:  eyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJeyJ.a.b

case: token prefixes that never complete
in:   ghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_ey
out:  ghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_eyghs_a_ey

case: dots between empty segments
in:   eyJ..eyJ..eyJ..eyJ..
out:  eyJ..eyJ..eyJ..eyJ..

case: a token wrapped in control bytes
in:   \x00ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\x00
out:  \x00«github-token»\x00

case: a token followed by a carriage return and newline
in:   token=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\r\n
out:  token=«github-token»\r\n

case: a token between tabs
in:   \tghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\t
out:  \t«github-token»\t

case: a token followed by bytes that are not valid utf-8
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\xff\xfe
out:  «github-token»\xff\xfe

case: a token broken by a control byte
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdef\x00ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdef
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdef\x00ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdef

case: a token between multi-byte text
in:   日本語ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz日本語
out:  日本語«github-token»日本語

case: a jwt between multi-byte text
in:   日本語eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef日本語
out:  日本語«jwt»日本語

case: a space at either end of the text
in:   \x20ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\x20
out:  \x20«github-token»\x20
